---
title: Feedback and Feature Request Template
description: Copy-ready YAML template for collecting feedback and requests with conditional follow-up routing.
---

Use this template when you want one form to collect different types of product input and route each submission type to the most relevant follow-up questions.

## Full template

```yaml
version: 1
title: Feedback and Feature Request Form
description: Collect feedback, feature requests, and related context

sections:
  - id: section_1
    title: Submission Type
    fields:
      - id: response_type
        type: single_select
        label: Submission type
        options:
          - General Feedback
          - Feature Request
          - Bug Report
        validators:
          - required

      - id: contact_email
        type: email
        label: Contact email
        placeholder: name@example.com

      - id: page_url
        type: url
        label: Related page URL
        placeholder: https://example.com/page

      # Optional hidden context value (can be prefilled by URL parameters).
      # - id: source_context
      #   type: hidden
      #   label: Source context
      #   placeholder: web_app

    next:
      - when: data.response_type == "Feature Request"
        go: section_2
      - when: data.response_type == "Bug Report"
        go: section_3
      - else: section_4

  - id: section_2
    title: Feature Request Details
    fields:
      - id: feature_summary
        type: short_text
        label: Feature summary
        placeholder: Enter summary
        validators:
          - required

      - id: feature_request_details
        type: long_text
        label: Feature request details
        placeholder: Describe the requested feature
        validators:
          - required

      - id: feature_priority
        type: single_select
        label: Priority
        options:
          - Low
          - Medium
          - High
        validators:
          - required
    next: section_5

  - id: section_3
    title: Bug Report Details
    fields:
      - id: bug_summary
        type: short_text
        label: Bug summary
        placeholder: Enter summary
        validators:
          - required

      - id: reproduction_steps
        type: long_text
        label: Reproduction steps
        placeholder: Describe how to reproduce the issue
        validators:
          - required

      - id: screenshot_or_file
        type: file_upload
        label: Screenshot or file
        placeholder: Upload file
    next: section_5

  - id: section_4
    title: Feedback Details
    fields:
      - id: rating
        type: rating
        label: Rating
        min_label: Low
        max_label: High
        validators:
          - required

      - id: feedback_message
        type: long_text
        label: Feedback message
        placeholder: Share your feedback
        validators:
          - required
    next: section_5

  - id: section_5
    title: Final Preferences
    fields:
      - id: follow_up_permission
        type: single_select
        label: Allow follow-up
        options:
          - Yes
          - No
        validators:
          - required
    next: done

completion:
  title: Thank you for your submission
  message: Your response has been received.
  button:
    label: Return
    url: https://example.com

# Optional notifications and routing to your team.
# connections:
#   - type: webhook
#     url: https://example.com/webhook/feedback
#
#   - type: email
#     to: team@example.com
#     subject: "New form submission - {{form.title}}"
#     include_responses: true
#
# Optional respondent confirmation.
#   - type: email
#     to: "{{data.contact_email}}"
#     subject: Submission received
#     body: |
#       Thanks for your submission.
#
# Optional analytics.
# mixpanel: replace_with_mixpanel_project_token
#
# Optional localization setup (add localized strings to titles/labels when needed).
# locale: en
```

## Customize this template

Change the `response_type` options and the `section_1.next` rule list to match the categories you collect. The template routes categories to separate sections so each path stays focused and the final preferences section can be reused.

If you only need one input type, remove the unused sections and simplify `section_1.next` to a fixed section ID or `done`. The shared final section can stay in place or be removed depending on whether follow-up permission is required.

Uncomment only the integration blocks you plan to use and replace placeholder values before deploying. The optional email, webhook, and analytics blocks are included so you can enable notifications without changing the core form structure.
